shortDescription: Focused code review with a two-attempt Jev budget
longDescription: Your coding assistant implements and validates; Jev supplies independent quality signals for focused diffs. Includes local MCP tools, credential setup and a bounded review skill. Requires Node.js 20+ and your own TypeSafe API key.
